scripts.db:test: set -a && . ./.env.local && supabase db query --db-url "$DATABASE_URL" -f supabase/tests/isolation.sql 2>&1 | grep -q "all checks passed" && echo "isolation: all checks passed" || (supabase db query --db-url "$DATABASE_URL" -f supabase/tests/isolation.sql; exit 1)
scripts.db:types: set -a && . ./.env.local && supabase gen types typescript --db-url "$DATABASE_URL" --schema public > src/lib/supabase/types.ts
